01-web-browsers-overview.md.description: Module 06 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 1 --- A web browser is a software application that allows you to access and view websites on the internet. It reads the code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) that makes up a web page and displays it as text, images, videos, and interactive elements on your screen. 03-search-engines.md.title: Search Engines
03-search-engines.md.description: Module 06 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 3 --- A search engine is a website or software that helps you find information on the internet by searching through billions of web pages. You type a query (what you want to find), and the search engine returns a list of relevant results. Simple Definition: A search engine is like a librarian for the entire internet — you ask a question, and it finds the best answers from billions of web pages. CCC Exam...

04-bookmarks-downloads.md.title: Bookmarks and Downloads
04-bookmarks-downloads.md.description: Module 06 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 4 --- A bookmark (also called a favorite in some browsers) is a saved shortcut to a web page. Instead of typing the full URL every time you want to visit a website, you can simply click the bookmark. Simple Analogy: A bookmark in a browser works just like a bookmark in a physical book — it marks a page so you can quickly find it again later. --- 1. Open the website you want to bookmark 2.
